personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A futuristic, dopamine-driven command center for NDIS support workers, combining medical-blue authority with high-clarity tech UI.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for clear grouping. Cards never flush to edge, minimum md margin.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Featured dashboard metric cards over the dark cyan background

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-clarity command center offering top-left priority statistics, Z-pattern flow for quick actions, and glancing task planner.

states.loading: Centered teal spinner with a pulsing glow effect.
states.empty: N/A for dashboard, but sections will show 'No active tasks' with a medical-blue abstract illustration.
states.error: Readable text with a 'Retry Sync' secondary CTA.

screens.layout: Hero metric row (Earnings/Tasks) with 24px+ typography. Next row contains quick actions (Scan Receipt, New Invoice). Bottom section contains a timeline feed for the daily planner. Use dark gradient backgrounds with subtle noise texture to elevate the futuristic feel.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: AI photo receipt extraction with immediate confidence-check validation.

states.loading: Simulated 'Scanning...' HUD overlay on the camera feed.
states.empty: Camera viewfinder filling the screen with corner crop guidelines.
states.error: Error modal if document not detected.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view as hero. After snap, use a Gorhom bottom sheet to display extracted data in a readable vertical form. Highlight extracted fields with color-coded confidence indicators (e.g., green for high confidence) and provide an edit button.

screens.name: InvoiceBuilder
screens.purpose: Fast invoice creation utilizing voice dictation and NDIS prefill hot-keys.

states.loading: Skeleton UI mimicking the form structure.
states.empty: Clean blank form with NDIS hot-keys clearly accessible above the keyboard.

screens.layout: Single column form structure with labels above inputs. Sticky primary CTA 'Generate Invoice' at bottom. Microphone icon inside text areas triggers a glowing cyan border and pulsing animation to indicate listening.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Dark futuristic abstract background with teal glowing curves

receipt_scan_placeholder.alt: Blank piece of paper to demonstrate scanning area

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark-first utility palette with electric cyan accents. This explicitly satisfies the user's request for a 'deep teal/medical-blue with cyan accents' command-center aesthetic, bypassing the general ban on blue for this specific case.
Implement the 'Voice Input' visual feedback clearly: when dictation is active, change the text area's border to `brandPrimary` (cyan) and add an opacity pulse animation.

Implement 'Dopamine Moments' for task completions and invoice payments using Reanimated. Examples: a brief, bright cyan glow over the success card, scaling up slightly (1.02x scale), paired with a 'success' haptic feedback.

For the scanner flow, render extracted data in an expandable bottom-sheet over the captured image. Use confidence indicators (e.g., small green circles or text 'AI Confidence: 95%') next to fields like 'Total' and 'Date'.
Always use 'expo-image' with a top-down gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) for text readability over the dashboard hero background.
